name: San4San
summary: A named street gang whose emblem has been spotted in GTA VI promotional footage. Its membership, territory, and story role have not been established by Rockstar.
description: San4San is a named faction. Its emblem appears in trailer footage. The gang’s identity, activities, and any connection to earlier Vice City factions remain unconfirmed; theories about its origins should be treated as speculation.

seo.title: San4San Gang Profile
seo.description: What is known and still unconfirmed about San4San, the named GTA VI faction whose emblem appears in promotional footage.
